title: checking whether a newspaper is free to take

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Are you done with this newspaper?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: A. It comes out on Fridays. B. I bought it this morning. C. You can take it with you.
turns.zh: A. 這份報紙每週五出版。 B. 我今天早上買的。 C. 你可以把它帶走。
